beats.event: Ashvapati wins a daughter by long penance; Savitri is born
She grows so radiant that no suitor dares approach her
Her father tells her to travel and choose her own husband
She chooses Satyavan, exiled son of blind King Dyumatsena
Sage Narada warns Satyavan will die in exactly one year
She marries him anyway and takes the hermit garb of the forest
Serves her parents-in-law faithfully as the year runs down
Three days from the fated hour she keeps a vow of fast and standing
On the day, she follows Satyavan into the forest to gather wood
Satyavan collapses; he dies with his head in her lap
Yama himself arrives; she follows him and Satyavan's soul
Her dharma-talk wins boons: her father-in-law's sight and kingdom
She asks for sons by Satyavan, trapping Yama in his own boon
Yama restores Satyavan to life and blesses them both
Kingdom restored; in time she bears a hundred sons
